sanskrit: tac chūlam antarā rāmaś ciccheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ tad dṛṣṭvā duṣkaraṃ karma rāvaṇaṃ bhayam āviśat
english: Rāma cut that trident in mid-flight with his keen arrows; seeing that feat so hard to accomplish, fear entered Rāvaṇa.

sanskrit: tataḥ kruddhaḥ sasarjāśu daśagrīvaḥ śitāñ śarān sahasrāyutaśo rāme śastrāṇi vividhāni ca
english: Then the ten-headed one, enraged, quickly hurled against Rāma sharp arrows by the thousands and ten-thousands, and weapons of every kind.

sanskrit: tato bhuśuṇḍīḥ śūlāṃś ca musalāni paraśvadhān śaktīś ca vividhākārāḥ śataghnīś ca śitakṣurāḥ
english: He also launched iron clubs, spears, pestles, battle-axes, lances of every shape, hundred-slayers, and razor-edged missiles.

sanskrit: tāṃ māyāṃ vikṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ bhayāt pradudruvuḥ sarve vānarāḥ sarvatodiśam
english: Beholding that terrible sorcery of the ten-necked demon, all the monkeys fled in terror in every direction.

sanskrit: tataḥ supatraṃ sumukhaṃ hemapuṅkhaṃ śarottamam tūṇād ādāya kākutstho brahmāstreṇa yuyoja ha
english: Then Kākutstha took from his quiver that supreme arrow — well-feathered, fair-nocked, gold-flighted — and charged it with the Brahmā-weapon.

sanskrit: taṃ bāṇavaryaṃ rāmeṇa brahmāstreṇābhimantritam jahṛṣur devagandharvā dṛṣṭvā śakrapurogamāḥ
english: Seeing that best of arrows consecrated by Rāma with the Brahmā-weapon, the gods and Gandharvas headed by Indra rejoiced.

sanskrit: alpāvaśeṣam āyuś ca tato 'manyanta rakṣasaḥ brahmāstrodīraṇāc chatror devagandharvakiṃnarāḥ
english: Then the gods, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras understood that only a little of the demon's life remained, seeing the enemy discharge the Brahmā-weapon.

sanskrit: tataḥ sasarja taṃ rāmaḥ śaram apratimaujasam rāvaṇāntakaraṃ ghoraṃ brahmadaṇḍam ivodyatam
english: Then Rāma released that arrow of matchless energy — dreadful, the very end of Rāvaṇa — like Brahmā's staff raised on high.

sanskrit: sa tena rākṣasaśreṣṭhaḥ sarathaḥ sāśvasārathiḥ prajajvāla mahājvālenāgninābhipariṣkṛtaḥ
english: Struck by it, that foremost of demons blazed up together with his chariot, horses, and charioteer, wrapped in a great fire and engulfed in flames.

sanskrit: tataḥ prahṛṣṭās tridaśāḥ sagandharvāḥ sacāraṇāḥ nihataṃ rāvaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā
english: Then the thirty gods, together with Gandharvas and Cāraṇas, were filled with joy upon seeing Rāvaṇa slain by Rāma of effortless deeds.

sanskrit: tatyajus taṃ mahābhāgaṃ pañca bhūtāni rāvaṇam bhraṃśitaḥ sarvalokeṣu sa hi brahmāstratejasā
english: The five great elements abandoned the illustrious Rāvaṇa, for by the power of the Brahmā-weapon he was cast out from all the worlds.

sanskrit: śarīradhātavo hy asya māṃsaṃ rudhiram eva ca neśur brahmāstranirdagdhā na ca bhasmāpy adṛśyata
english: His bodily constituents — flesh and blood alike — were utterly consumed by the Brahmā-weapon; not even ashes were to be seen.

sanskrit: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca sa hatvā rāvaṇaṃ kṣudraṃ rākṣasendraṃ suradviṣam babhūva hṛṣṭaḥ sasuhṛd rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha
english: Mārkaṇḍeya said: Having slain that base enemy of the gods, the lord of the Rākṣasas Rāvaṇa, Rāma became filled with delight together with his friends and with Saumitri.

sanskrit: tato hate daśagrīve devāḥ sarṣipurogamāḥ āśīrbhir jayayuktābhir ānarcus taṃ mahābhujam
english: Then, with the ten-headed one slain, the gods led by the sages honored that mighty-armed hero with blessings of victory.

sanskrit: rāmaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ sarvadevatāḥ gandharvāḥ puṣpavarṣaiś ca vāgbhiś ca tridaśālayāḥ
english: All the divinities praised lotus-eyed Rāma; the Gandharvas and dwellers in the celestial realm rained flowers upon him and glorified him with hymns.

sanskrit: pūjayitvā yathā rāmaṃ pratijagmur yathāgatam tan mahotsavasaṃkāśam āsīd ākāśam acyuta
english: Having honored Rāma as was fitting, they returned the way they had come; the sky, O Acyuta, looked like a great festival.

sanskrit: tato hatvā daśagrīvaṃ laṅkāṃ rāmo mahāyaśāḥ vibhīṣaṇāya pradadau prabhuḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
english: Then Rāma of great fame, conqueror of enemy cities, having slain the ten-headed one, gave Laṅkā as a gift to Vibhīṣaṇa.

sanskrit: tataḥ sītāṃ puraskṛtya vibhīṣaṇapuraskṛtām avindhyo nāma suprajño vṛddhāmātyo viniryayau
english: Then Avindhya, a wise old minister, leading Sītā — who had been placed under Vibhīṣaṇa's escort — came forward.

sanskrit: uvāca ca mahātmānaṃ kākutsthaṃ dainyam āsthitam pratīccha devīṃ sadvṛttāṃ mahātmañ jānakīm iti
english: And he spoke to the great-souled Kākutstha, who stood humbled: 'Great soul, receive the Lady Jānakī, she who is of virtuous conduct.'

sanskrit: etac chrutvā vacas tasmād avatīrya rathottamāt bāṣpeṇāpihitāṃ sītāṃ dadarśekṣvākunandanaḥ
english: Hearing those words from him and descending from his excellent chariot, the scion of the Ikṣvāku line beheld Sītā whose face was veiled in tears.

sanskrit: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīṃ yānasthāṃ śokakarśitām malopacitasarvāṅgīṃ jaṭilāṃ kṛṣṇavāsasam
english: He saw her — lovely in every limb yet wasted by grief as she sat in her palanquin, her whole body smeared with grime, her hair matted, clad in dark garments.

sanskrit: uvāca rāmo vaidehīṃ parāmarśaviśaṅkitaḥ gaccha vaidehi muktā tvaṃ yat kāryaṃ tan mayā kṛtam
english: Rāma, troubled by suspicion of her having been touched, spoke to Vaidehī: 'Go, Vaidehī, you are free; what needed to be done has been done by me.'

sanskrit: mām āsādya patiṃ bhadre na tvaṃ rākṣasaveśmani jarāṃ vrajethā iti me nihato 'sau niśācaraḥ
english: 'So that you, auspicious one, having me as your husband, should not grow old in a demon's dwelling — for that reason this night-ranger has been slain by me.'

sanskrit: kathaṃ hy asmadvidho jātu jānan dharmaviniścayam parahastagatāṃ nārīṃ muhūrtam api dhārayet
english: 'For how could one like me, knowing the settled rule of dharma, accept even for a moment a woman who has passed into another man's hands?'

sanskrit: suvṛttām asuvṛttāṃ vāpy ahaṃ tvām adya maithili notsahe paribhogāya śvāvalīḍhaṃ havir yathā
english: 'Whether you have kept good conduct or not, O Maithilī, I cannot bring myself to take you back for enjoyment — like an oblation licked by a dog.'

sanskrit: tataḥ sā sahasā bālā tac chrutvā dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ papāta devī vyathitā nikṛttā kadalī yathā
english: Then that young goddess, having suddenly heard those cruel words, fell to the ground in anguish, like a plantain tree cut down.

sanskrit: yo hy asyā harṣasaṃbhūto mukharāgas tadābhavat kṣaṇena sa punar bhraṣṭo niḥśvāsād iva darpaṇe
english: For the flush of joy that had risen to her face vanished in an instant, like breath from a mirror.

sanskrit: tatas te harayaḥ sarve tac chrutvā rāmabhāṣitam gatāsukalpā niśceṣṭā babhūvuḥ sahalakṣmaṇāḥ
english: Then all those monkeys, hearing Rāma's speech, stood motionless as if bereft of life, along with Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: tato devo viśuddhātmā vimānena caturmukhaḥ pitāmaho jagatsraṣṭā darśayām āsa rāghavam
english: Then the god of pure soul, the four-faced Grandsire, creator of the world, revealed himself to Rāghava in his celestial vehicle.

sanskrit: śakraś cāgniś ca vāyuś ca yamo varuṇa eva ca yakṣādhipaś ca bhagavāṃs tathā saptarṣayo 'malāḥ
english: Indra and Agni and Vāyu, Yama and Varuṇa, the blessed lord of the Yakṣas, and the seven pure sages as well —

sanskrit: rājā daśarathaś caiva divyabhāsvaramūrtimān vimānena mahārheṇa haṃsayuktena bhāsvatā
english: — and King Daśaratha too, his form radiant with divine splendor, in a magnificent celestial vehicle yoked with swans and blazing with light —

sanskrit: tato 'ntarikṣaṃ tat sarvaṃ devagandharvasaṃkulam śuśubhe tārakācitraṃ śaradīva nabhastalam
english: Then all that sky, filled with gods and Gandharvas, shone beautifully, dotted with stars, like the autumn firmament.

sanskrit: tata utthāya vaidehi teṣāṃ madhye yaśasvinī uvāca vākyaṃ kalyāṇī rāmaṃ pṛthulavakṣasam
english: Then Vaidehī, the auspicious and glorious one, rising up in the midst of them, spoke these words to broad-chested Rāma:

sanskrit: rājaputra na te kopaṃ karomi viditā hi me gatiḥ strīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama
english: 'O prince, I bear you no anger, for I know well the way of men toward women. But hear these words of mine.

sanskrit: antaś carati bhūtānāṃ mātariśvā sadāgatiḥ sa me vimuñcatu prāṇān yadi pāpaṃ carāmy aham
english: 'Mātariśvan, who ever moves within all living beings, let him release my life-breath if I have committed any sin.

sanskrit: agnir āpas tathākāśaṃ pṛthivī vāyur eva ca vimuñcantu mama prāṇān yadi pāpaṃ carāmy aham
english: 'Fire, water, sky, earth, and wind — let them all release my life-breath if I have committed any sin.'

sanskrit: tato 'ntarikṣe vāg āsīt sarvā viśrāvayan diśaḥ puṇyā saṃharṣaṇī teṣāṃ vānarāṇāṃ mahātmanām
english: Then from the sky arose a voice resounding in all directions, holy and filling those great-souled monkeys with joy.

sanskrit: vāyur uvāca bho bho rāghava satyaṃ vai vāyur asmi sadāgatiḥ apāpā maithilī rājan saṃgaccha saha bhāryayā
english: Vāyu said: 'Ho, Rāghava! I am indeed Vāyu, who ever moves without ceasing. Maithilī is sinless, O king; be united with your wife.'

sanskrit: agnir uvāca aham antaḥśarīrastho bhūtānāṃ raghunandana susūkṣmam api kākutstha maithilī nāparādhyati
english: Agni said: 'I dwell within the bodies of all beings, O joy of the Raghus. Not even in the subtlest degree has Maithilī transgressed, O Kākutstha.'

sanskrit: varuṇa uvāca rasā vai matprasūtā hi bhūtadeheṣu rāghava ahaṃ vai tvāṃ prabravīmi maithilī pratigṛhyatām
english: Varuṇa said: 'The vital fluids that pervade the bodies of all beings spring from me, O Rāghava. I declare to you: let Maithilī be received back.'

sanskrit: brahmovāca putra naitad ihāścaryaṃ tvayi rājarṣidharmiṇi sādho sadvṛttamārgasthe śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama
english: Brahmā said: 'Son, this is no wonder in you who uphold the dharma of a royal sage, O virtuous one who walks the path of right conduct. Hear these words of mine.

sanskrit: śatrur eṣa tvayā vīra devagandharvabhoginām yakṣāṇāṃ dānavānāṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ ca pātitaḥ
english: 'This enemy of the gods, Gandharvas, Bhogins, Yakṣas, Dānavas, and great sages has been laid low by you, O hero.

sanskrit: avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ matprasādāt purābhavat kasmāc cit kāraṇāt pāpaḥ kaṃ cit kālam upekṣitaḥ
english: 'He had formerly become unkillable by all beings through my grace, and for some reason this sinful one was overlooked for a time.

sanskrit: vadhārtham ātmanas tena hṛtā sītā durātmanā nalakūbaraśāpena rakṣā cāsyāḥ kṛtā mayā
english: 'Sītā was abducted by that evil-souled one so as to bring about his own death, and I arranged her protection through the curse of Nalakūbara.

sanskrit: yadi hy akāmām āsevet striyam anyām api dhruvam śatadhāsya phaled deha ity uktaḥ so 'bhavat purā
english: 'For it was declared of old that if he were to violate any woman against her will, his body would assuredly split into a hundred pieces.

sanskrit: nātra śaṅkā tvayā kāryā pratīcchemāṃ mahādyute kṛtaṃ tvayā mahat kāryaṃ devānām amaraprabha
english: 'You must harbor no doubt here; receive her back, O greatly resplendent one. A great service to the gods has been done by you, O one equal to the immortals.'

sanskrit: daśaratha uvāca prīto 'smi vatsa bhadraṃ te pitā daśaratho 'smi te anujānāmi rājyaṃ ca praśādhi puruṣottama
english: Daśaratha said: 'I am pleased, dear child; may good come to you. I am your father Daśaratha. I grant you permission — rule the kingdom, O best of men.'

sanskrit: rāma uvāca abhivādaye tvāṃ rājendra yadi tvaṃ janako mama gamiṣyāmi purīṃ ramyām ayodhyāṃ śāsanāt tava
english: Rāma said: 'I pay homage to you, O king of kings. If you are indeed my father, then by your command I shall go to the beautiful city of Ayodhyā.'

sanskrit: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tam uvāca pitā bhūyaḥ prahṛṣṭo manujādhipa gacchāyodhyāṃ praśādhi tvaṃ rāma raktāntalocana
english: Mārkaṇḍeya said: His father spoke to him again, greatly delighted, O lord of men: 'Go to Ayodhyā and rule it, O Rāma of red-cornered eyes.'

sanskrit: tato devān namaskṛtya suhṛdbhir abhinanditaḥ mahendra iva paulomyā bhāryayā sa sameyivān
english: Then, having bowed to the gods and been celebrated by his friends, he was reunited with his wife, even as Mahendra with Paulomī.

sanskrit: tato varaṃ dadau tasmai avindhyāya paraṃtapaḥ trijaṭāṃ cārthamānābhyāṃ yojayām āsa rākṣasīm
english: Then the scorcher of foes granted a boon to Avindhya, and he appointed the Rākṣasī Trijaṭā, who had been sought for her virtuous service, to tend Sītā.

sanskrit: tam uvāca tato brahmā devaiḥ śakramukhair vṛtaḥ kausalyāmātar iṣṭāṃs te varān adya dadāni kān
english: Then Brahmā, surrounded by the gods headed by Indra, spoke to him: 'O son of Kausalyā, what boons do you desire? I grant them to you today.'

sanskrit: vavre rāmaḥ sthitiṃ dharme śatrubhiś cāparājayam rākṣasair nihatānāṃ ca vānarāṇāṃ samudbhavam
english: Rāma chose steadfastness in dharma, invincibility against enemies, and the revival of the monkeys who had been slain by the Rākṣasas.

sanskrit: tatas te brahmaṇā prokte tatheti vacane tadā samuttasthur mahārāja vānarā labdhacetasaḥ
english: Then, O great king, when Brahmā had spoken those words 'so be it,' the monkeys rose up, their consciousness restored.

sanskrit: sītā cāpi mahābhāgā varaṃ hanumate dadau rāmakīrtyā samaṃ putra jīvitaṃ te bhaviṣyati
english: The greatly blessed Sītā too granted a boon to Hanumān: 'Your life, my son, shall be equal to the fame of Rāma.'

sanskrit: divyās tvām upabhogāś ca matprasādakṛtāḥ sadā upasthāsyanti hanumann iti sma harilocana
english: 'And divine pleasures, granted by my favor, shall always be present for you, O Hanumān' — so she spoke, O monkey-eyed one.

sanskrit: tatas te prekṣamāṇānāṃ teṣām akliṣṭakarmaṇām antardhānaṃ yayur devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ
english: Then, as those men of effortless deeds looked on, all the gods headed by Indra vanished from sight.

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvā tu rāmaṃ jānakyā sametaṃ śakrasārathiḥ uvāca paramaprītaḥ suhṛnmadhya idaṃ vacaḥ
english: But Mātali, charioteer of Indra, seeing Rāma reunited with Jānakī, was filled with the greatest joy and spoke these words in the midst of the friends:

sanskrit: devagandharvayakṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāsurabhoginām apanītaṃ tvayā duḥkham idaṃ satyaparākrama
english: 'The suffering of gods, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, humans, Asuras, and Bhogins has been removed by you, O true hero of real valor.'

sanskrit: sadevāsuragandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ kathayiṣyanti lokās tvāṃ yāvad bhūmir dhariṣyati
english: 'The worlds — gods, Asuras, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, and serpents — shall sing of you for as long as the earth endures.'

sanskrit: ity evam uktvānujñāpya rāmaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ varam saṃpūjyāpākramat tena rathenādityavarcasā
english: Having thus spoken and taken leave of Rāma, best of weapon-bearers, and having duly honored him, Mātali departed in that chariot blazing like the sun.

sanskrit: tataḥ sītāṃ puraskṛtya rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha sugrīvapramukhaiś caiva sahitaḥ sarvavānaraiḥ
english: Then Rāma, placing Sītā at his side, together with Saumitri and all the monkeys headed by Sugrīva,

sanskrit: vidhāya rakṣāṃ laṅkāyāṃ vibhīṣaṇapuraskṛtaḥ saṃtatāra punas tena setunā makarālayam
english: having arranged the protection of Laṅkā with Vibhīṣaṇa at the fore, crossed again over the sea — the abode of sea-monsters — by that same bridge.

sanskrit: puṣpakeṇa vimānena khecareṇa virājatā kāmagena yathā mukhyair amātyaiḥ saṃvṛto vaśī
english: Accompanied by his chief ministers as was fitting, the self-controlled one traveled in the Puṣpaka celestial vehicle, that sky-farer blazing with splendor, that goes wherever one wishes.

sanskrit: tatas tīre samudrasya yatra śiśye sa pārthivaḥ tatraivovāsa dharmātmā sahitaḥ sarvavānaraiḥ
english: Then at the shore of the ocean, at the very place where that king had rested before, the righteous-souled one halted together with all the monkeys.

sanskrit: athainān rāghavaḥ kāle samānīyābhipūjya ca visarjayām āsa tadā ratnaiḥ saṃtoṣya sarvaśaḥ
english: Then, in due time, Rāghava summoned them, honored them, satisfied them thoroughly with jewels, and dismissed them.

sanskrit: gateṣu vānarendreṣu gopuccharkṣeṣu teṣu ca sugrīvasahito rāmaḥ kiṣkindhāṃ punar āgamat
english: When the monkey-lords and the bear-tailed bears had departed, Rāma together with Sugrīva returned once more to Kiṣkindhā.

sanskrit: vibhīṣaṇenānugataḥ sugrīvasahitas tadā puṣpakeṇa vimānena vaidehyā darśayan vanam
english: Accompanied by Vibhīṣaṇa and together with Sugrīva, he showed Vaidehī the forests from the Puṣpaka celestial vehicle.

sanskrit: kiṣkindhāṃ tu samāsādya rāmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ aṅgadaṃ kṛtakarmāṇaṃ yauvarājye 'bhyaṣecayat
english: Having arrived at Kiṣkindhā, Rāma, best of warriors, consecrated Aṅgada — who had distinguished himself in battle — as crown prince.

sanskrit: tatas tair eva sahito rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha yathāgatena mārgeṇa prayayau svapuraṃ prati
english: Then Rāma, together with those same companions and with Saumitri, set out toward his own city by the same way they had come.

sanskrit: ayodhyāṃ sa samāsādya purīṃ rāṣṭrapatis tataḥ bharatāya hanūmantaṃ dūtaṃ prasthāpayat tadā
english: Having approached the city of Ayodhyā, the lord of the realm then dispatched Hanūmān as a messenger to Bharata.

sanskrit: lakṣayitveṅgitaṃ sarvaṃ priyaṃ tasmai nivedya ca vāyuputre punaḥ prāpte nandigrāmam upāgamat
english: Having read all of Bharata's signals and reported the glad tidings to him, when the son of Vāyu returned, Rāma went to Nandigrāma.

sanskrit: sa tatra maladigdhāṅgaṃ bharataṃ cīravāsasam agrataḥ pāduke kṛtvā dadarśāsīnam āsane
english: There he saw Bharata, his body smeared with grime, clad in bark garments, seated upon a seat with the sandals placed before him.

sanskrit: sametya bharatenātha śatrughnena ca vīryavān rāghavaḥ sahasaumitrir mumude bharatarṣabha
english: Having met with Bharata and with Śatrughna, O bull among Bharatas, the valiant Rāghava rejoiced together with Saumitri.

sanskrit: tathā bharataśatrughnau sametau guruṇā tadā vaidehyā darśanenobhau praharṣaṃ samavāpatuḥ
english: Likewise Bharata and Śatrughna, reunited with their elder, were filled with great joy at the sight of Vaidehī.

sanskrit: tasmai tad bharato rājyam āgatāyābhisatkṛtam nyāsaṃ niryātayām āsa yuktaḥ paramayā mudā
english: Bharata, suffused with supreme delight, restored to the returning hero that kingdom which had been held as a trust for him and had been properly honored.

sanskrit: tatas taṃ vaiṣṇave śūraṃ nakṣatre 'bhimate 'hani vasiṣṭho vāmadevaś ca sahitāv abhyaṣiñcatām
english: Then Vasiṣṭha and Vāmadeva together consecrated that hero on an auspicious day under a Vaiṣṇava asterism.

sanskrit: so 'bhiṣiktaḥ kapiśreṣṭhaṃ sugrīvaṃ sasuhṛjjanam vibhīṣaṇaṃ ca paulastyam anvajānād gṛhān prati
english: Once consecrated, he gave leave to Sugrīva, best of monkeys, together with his companions, and to Vibhīṣaṇa of the line of Pulastya, to return to their homes.

sanskrit: abhyarcya vividhai ratnaiḥ prītiyuktau mudā yutau samādhāyetikartavyaṃ duḥkhena visasarja ha
english: Having honored them with various gems, and both filled with love and joy, having made all proper arrangements, he dismissed them with a sorrowful heart.

sanskrit: puṣpakaṃ ca vimānaṃ tat pūjayitvā sa rāghavaḥ prādād vaiśravaṇāyaiva prītyā sa raghunandanaḥ
english: And that Puṣpaka celestial vehicle — having reverently honored it, that son of Raghu, that Rāghava, joyfully returned it to Vaiśravaṇa himself.
